{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/penguins.csv'
penguins = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check unique species
print("Unique species:")
print(penguins['species'].unique())

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm for accuracy
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length per species
mean_flipper_by_species = penguins_clean.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Find species with highest mean flipper length
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()

# Output results
print("\nMean flipper length by species:")
print(mean_flipper_by_species)

highest_mean_species"}
